description: This class implements a client for interacting with Supabase Storage via REST API. It provides functionality to generate signed URLs for private objects stored in a specific bucket, using service role credentials. The class registers as a Spring component and leverages configuration properties for setup.

classes.name: SupabaseStorageClient
classes.description: A Spring component that provides methods to generate signed URLs for files stored in Supabase storage. It manages configuration and constructs REST calls to the Supabase API.

methods.name: createSignedUrl
methods.description: Generates a signed URL for accessing a private object in the claims bucket, with specified expiration time in seconds.

methods.name: getClaimsBucket
methods.description: Returns the name of the claims bucket used for storage.
